'''Foussballclub Etzella Ettelbréck''', abbreviated to either '''FC Etzella''' or '''Etzella Ettelbruck''', is a [[association football|football]] club based in [[Ettelbruck]], in north-eastern [[Luxembourg]]. Etzella play in the [[Luxembourg National Division|National Division]], the top tier of Luxembourgish football, since their promotion at the end of the 2025–26 season.

Together with the [[Luxembourg Football Federation|FLF]], Etzella host an annual National Football Day ({{langx|fr|Journée nationale du football}}), bringing together the youth teams of Luxembourg football clubs.<ref>{{cite web |title=36e Journée nationale du football à Ettelbruck |url=https://www.flf.lu/post-296485v4/posts/60418 |website=FLF.lu |access-date=18 September 2025 |language=fr |trans-title=36th National football day in Ettelbruck}}</ref>"}}
